entries.title: A batch can recover when GitHub loses its verdict
entries.body: When GitHub returns no verdict, the queue starts a fresh batch instead of immediately pausing your changes. A second missing verdict pauses with the recorded results, without inventing a failed check. Only successful verification can pass the new batch. Your first mate offers a project's queue the update.
entries.noPicture: This changes the queue's written diagnostic and restart behavior, not a screen in the app.
